description: Audited synthetic benchmark: expected controls and canonical metadata are checked against the production ISO/IEC 27001:2022 seed catalog. Findings test candidate narrowing and workflow behavior; they are not an independent 500-case AI accuracy evaluation.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.description: Limit access to information and systems based on business and security requirements.
controls.objective: Prevent unauthorized access to systems, applications, data, and services.

controls.title: Use of Cryptography
controls.description: Use cryptographic controls to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and authenticity of information.
controls.objective: Ensure data in transit and at rest is appropriately protected using cryptographic methods.

controls.title: Logging
controls.description: Produce, store, protect, and analyse logs that record relevant activities and events.
controls.objective: Create reliable event records that support security monitoring and investigation.

controls.title: Monitoring activities
controls.description: Monitor networks, systems, and applications for anomalous behaviour and potential incidents.
controls.objective: Detect anomalous activity and assess potential information security incidents.

controls.title: Networks security
controls.description: Protect networks and network services through appropriate technical and organizational controls.
controls.objective: Reduce unauthorized access to network resources and limit lateral movement across systems.

controls.title: Information Backup
controls.description: Implement backup procedures to protect information and support recovery from incidents or failures.
controls.objective: Ensure reliable recovery of systems, applications, and data when disruptions occur.

controls.title: Access Rights
controls.description: Grant, review, and remove access rights based on approved business and security requirements.
controls.objective: Ensure users and systems retain only the minimum necessary access for their roles.

controls.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.description: Obtain information about technical vulnerabilities and take appropriate measures to address them.
controls.objective: Reduce the likelihood and impact of exploitation of technical vulnerabilities.

controls.title: Secure authentication
controls.description: Implement secure authentication technologies and procedures appropriate to access risks.
controls.objective: Ensure users and systems authenticate securely before accessing information and services.

controls.title: Configuration management
controls.description: Establish, document, implement, monitor, and review configurations for technology.
controls.objective: Maintain secure and controlled configurations throughout the technology lifecycle.

controls.title: Segregation of networks
controls.description: Separate groups of information services, users, and systems within networks.
controls.objective: Limit exposure and lateral movement by controlling communication between network segments.

controls.title: Physical Security Perimeters
controls.description: Implement physical barriers to protect information systems and sensitive areas from unauthorized access.
controls.objective: Prevent unauthorized physical entry to sites, rooms, and critical infrastructure.

controls.title: Information Security Incident Management Planning and Preparation
controls.description: Prepare for information security incidents with defined roles, procedures, communications, and escalation paths.
controls.objective: Reduce the impact of incidents by ensuring that teams can respond quickly and consistently.

controls.title: Privacy and Protection of PII
controls.description: Protect Personally Identifiable Information (PII) through appropriate handling, access, retention, and disposal controls.
controls.objective: Preserve privacy and reduce the risk of unauthorized exposure of personal data.

controls.title: Information security in supplier relationships
controls.description: Manage information security risks arising from supplier products and services.
controls.objective: Protect organizational information and assets that are accessible to or affected by suppliers.
